Tokyo Game Show (TGS)
Tokyo Game Show (TGS)
Sep 17, 2026 TO Sep 21, 2026
|
Chiba City, Japan
This year, the TOKYO GAME SHOW is moving to a new stage. TGS, where games people from all over the world transcending age and national borders to play, connect, and envision the future, will expand to its longest-ever five days in 2026. With an increased scale in both the amount of play and the passion, a show dedicated to fully experiencing games will begin.
